objective: Re-review the capability registry repair for the symlink-following config write and any new security issue the repair introduces.
scope: Check that a symlinked .holyagent/config.json or .holyagent directory at project and local scope is refused before any write, that refuseLinks moved to setup/scope.ts still guards the .pi writes, that the user lock refusal cannot be bypassed by scope or flag order, and that a failed write stops package changes.
constraints: Do not check out other commits in any checkout and make no edits.
Report in under 300 words; substantiate each finding with source, sink, file and line, and mark it blocking or non-blocking.

criteria.text: The symlink write is refused and the repair adds no new path to install, remove or write beyond the pinned registry entries
